activity_prompts.title: Prompts
activity_prompts.intro: Every system prompt in one place: the platform's activities and each assistant's templates. Each one is edited here and saved where it lives.
activity_prompts.empty_means_code: Leave it empty to use the text from code, so it keeps improving as the code improves.
activity_prompts.save_failed: Could not save. Check that the variables in the text exist for this activity.
activity_prompts.ambito: Activities are platform configuration, shared by every organisation. Templates hang off an assistant, and you only see those of the organisations you manage.
activity_prompts.plantillas_intro: Each assistant's system templates. They hang off a chatbot and vary by language, so they are edited here but saved where they live.
activity_prompts.plantilla_guardar_fallo: The template could not be saved.

hub.availability_hint: Leave the dates empty so the chatbot never expires. It applies itself; no need to switch it off by hand.
hub.chatbot_install_desc: Include this code in your web page:
hub.chatbot_long_context_error: The corpus exceeds the MD_LONG_CONTEXT mode limit (128K tokens). Reduce the corpus or switch to MD_AGENT_SELECTOR.
hub.chatbot_model_hint: LLM configuration this chatbot will use. Managed under Model settings.
hub.chatbot_retrieval_hint_agentic: The LLM decides which documents to read during the conversation using tools. No corpus limit, but slower.
hub.chatbot_retrieval_hint_long_context: Puts every whole document into the prompt (max. 128k context tokens). Useful for small collections where the overall picture matters.
hub.chatbot_retrieval_hint_rag: Retrieves the most relevant chunks by semantic search. Recommended for large knowledge bases.
hub.chatbot_top_k_hint: Number of chunks retrieved per query (1–50). Recommended value: 8.
hub.corpus_markdown_only: The corpus only accepts Markdown from the curation pipeline. Originals (PDF and others) are converted there first, which is where the conversion gets reviewed.
hub.delete_doc_copias_one: This norm is also in 1 other chatbot of the organisation. Unless you tick the box, it stays there.
hub.delete_doc_copias_other: This norm is also in {{count}} other chatbots of the organisation. Unless you tick the box, it stays there.
hub.delete_doc_en_todos: Delete it in every chatbot of the organisation too
hub.delete_doc_text: The document and all its indexed chunks will be deleted.
hub.drag_drop: Drag and drop your Markdown (.md) files here
hub.language_mode_fixed_ayuda: Always answers in the chosen language, whatever the question is written in, and prefers that version of the rule.
hub.language_mode_none_ayuda: Neither detects nor instructs a language. For a single-language corpus, where detection adds nothing.
hub.language_mode_prefer: Prefer the language of the question
hub.language_mode_prefer_ayuda: Detects the language of the question, answers in it and prefers that version of the rule when one exists. This is the default.
hub.llm_config_api_key_hint: Name of the environment variable holding the key (optional if the provider already has one).
hub.llm_config_max_tokens_hint: Default: 12000 output tokens. The long-context window is configured separately (128K).
hub.llm_config_model_hint: Model list fetched dynamically for the selected provider.
hub.llm_configs_alcance_de_los_niveles: Tiers (1, 2, 3) are not only for Chatbots: Reports —copilot, script proposal and audit, drafts— and Curation —crawling and recognition— consume them too. Changing a tier’s model changes the behaviour of all three modules.
hub.max_size_10mb: Maximum size: 10 MB per file. Markdown (.md) format only.
hub.no_documents: No documents ingested for this chatbot.
hub.no_llm_configs: No LLM configuration has been registered
hub.provider_api_key_hint: If set, it will be used instead of the environment variable.
hub.quota_hint: Empty = inherit from the organisation · 0 = no limit. The per-IP quota is only for the anonymous widget and is not inherited.
hub.recalculate_non_vector_text: Vector chunks will be deleted; markdown documents are kept.
hub.recalculate_vector_text: Embeddings will be regenerated for all documents.
hub.reports_note_required: Write what should change: an «inadequate» with no reason does not let anyone reformulate anything
hub.retrieval_rec_agentic: The agent decides which chunks to read.
hub.retrieval_rec_lc: The full document is sent to the LLM on every query.
hub.select_chatbot_first: Create or select a chatbot first

test_scenarios.title: Test scenarios
test_scenarios.subtitle: Saved queries for reviewing by hand what the chatbot answers.
test_scenarios.empty: No scenarios for this chatbot yet.
test_scenarios.name: Name
test_scenarios.expectation_hint: In prose. Not checked automatically: it is the note the reviewer reads.
test_scenarios.capture_context_hint: Stores the final prompt and the resolved config alongside the answer.
test_scenarios.error_generic: Could not save. Check the data or try again.
test_scenarios.error_run: Could not run the scenario. Check that the chatbot's model responds.

hub.total_token_budget_hint: 0 = no ceiling. Once reached, the chatbot stops answering.
hub.unavailable_message_placeholder: The enrolment period ended on 30 September.

valores_por_defecto.alcance: Chatbots-module configuration applied to one organisation: graph profile, retrieval mode, chunking, reranker. It is not tenant identity, which is why it no longer lives on the Organisations screen.

hub.vigencia_all_ok: The whole corpus has its validity validated.
hub.vigencia_desc: Documents the assistant cites with a warning because nobody has checked whether they are still in force.
hub.vigencia_error_validar: Could not validate. Try again, or tell whoever administers the platform.
hub.vigencia_resumen: {{pendents}} of {{total}} corpus documents are pending validation.
hub.vigencia_sugerencia_retirar: It should be removed from the corpus, or its state corrected

no_encontrado.texto: The address you reached does not match any screen. Check the link in case it is incomplete.

sin_este_modulo.texto: Your account has access to other parts of the platform, but not this one. If you need it, ask your administrator and tell them the address you were opening.
sin_este_modulo.titulo: This section is not part of your account
sin_este_modulo.volver: Go to what you can open

sin_acceso.texto: Your account exists but no module has been granted. Ask the platform administrator for access, saying what you need: reports, chatbots or curation.
sin_acceso.titulo: You do not have access to any module yet

registro.descripcion: AI usage declared by tools outside the platform. Only metadata is recorded —who, with what, what for and with which model—, never the content.
registro.vacio: No activity recorded yet. It will appear here once an external tool starts declaring it with a token carrying the «actividad:write» scope.
registro.sin_resultados: No event matches the filter. Try widening the date range or clearing the tool name.

usuarios.alcance_organizacion: Who has an account in the organisations you administer, with which role and whether they have ever signed in. Creating people and changing roles is done by the platform administrator.
usuarios.alcance: Who has an account, with which role, and whether they have ever signed in. This is not every account: superadmin, partner and client accounts live in their own tables, not yet unified.
usuarios.aviso_autoridad_idp: On this deployment the identity provider decides the role (IDENTITY_ROLE_AUTHORITY=idp): whatever you change here will be overwritten at the next sign-in.
usuarios.contrasena_corta: The password needs at least {{minimo}} characters.
usuarios.contrasena_fijada: Password set. It is not shown again: send it over a secure channel.
usuarios.sin_contrasena: Adding a person does not create a password: identity is verified through institutional SSO.
usuarios.modulos_del_alta: Modules they will have access to
usuarios.pista_modulos: The role says what someone can do; the module, where they can go. With no module ticked, this person will not be able to enter anywhere.
usuarios.sin_concesion_directa_ayuda: This person has no module grant of their own. If they sign in through SSO they may still have access through an IdP group, which is not visible here. Grant them here when creating the person, or from Platform → Modules.

modulos.nota_superadmin: A superadministrator has every module without a grant: it is the platform role, and making it depend on a row would leave a fresh install with the superadministrator locked out. Do not look for their row here.
modulos.pista_grupo: The name must match what the IdP declares in its groups attribute (for example PDI or PTGAS). The comparison is case-insensitive. Granting to a group reaches the whole collective, including people who have never signed in.

identidad_visual.alcance: Colours, typography and logo. Each level inherits from the one above: the platform sets the base, an organisation adjusts it, and a single assistant can adjust it again.
identidad_visual.limites: PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB. SVG is deliberately excluded: it can carry scripts, and the logo is served without a session.
identidad_visual.formato_rechazado: That file is of type {{tipo}}. Only PNG and JPEG are accepted: SVG can carry scripts, and the logo is served without a session.
identidad_visual.demasiado_grande: The file is over 1 MB, the server limit. Shrink the image before uploading it.
